country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_OFFER.2
	title = COLDWAR_OFFER.2.t
	desc = COLDWAR_OFFER.2.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal
	is_triggered_only = yes

	option = { # accept: the former decision KOR_review_offer_df_foreign_purchase_board_accept_USA
		name = COLDWAR_OFFER_accept
		trigger = {
			tag = USA
			KOR = {
			has_country_flag = KOR_review_offer_df_foreign_purchase_board_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = KOR_review_signed_df_foreign_purchase_board }
			}
			NOT = { has_country_flag = KOR_review_offer_df_foreign_purchase_board_assent_USA }

			KOR = {
			KOR_review_valid_df_foreign_purchase_board = yes
			}

		}
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 2

		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_OFFER.2 option a"
		effect_tooltip = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = KOR_review_if_accepted
		custom_effect_tooltip = KOR_review_offer_df_foreign_purchase_board_country_KOR
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = mdcw_infantry_weapons_1955 amount = 600 producer = KOR }
		KOR = { set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = KOR.gdp_total } multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.0012 } modify_treasury_effect = yes } # IMPERIA COLD WAR — native MD treasury preview
		custom_effect_tooltip = KOR_review_offer_df_foreign_purchase_board_country_USA
		custom_effect_tooltip = KOR_review_equipment_df_foreign_purchase_board_USA
		USA = { set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = KOR.gdp_total } multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 0.0012 } modify_treasury_effect = yes } # IMPERIA COLD WAR — native MD treasury preview
		}
		hidden_effect = {
		if = {
		limit = {
		tag = USA
		KOR = {
		has_country_flag = KOR_review_offer_df_foreign_purchase_board_pending
		NOT = { has_country_flag = KOR_review_signed_df_foreign_purchase_board }
		}
		NOT = { has_country_flag = KOR_review_offer_df_foreign_purchase_board_assent_USA }
		KOR = {
		KOR_review_valid_df_foreign_purchase_board = yes
		}
		}
		set_country_flag = KOR_review_offer_df_foreign_purchase_board_assent_USA
		KOR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OFFER.1001 } } # IMPERIA COLD WAR — initiator applies its own part in its return event
		}
		}

	}
	option = { # refuse: the former decision KOR_review_offer_df_foreign_purchase_board_refuse_USA
		name = COLDWAR_OFFER_refuse
